test_resolution: test the TestResolution class to verify pd.period_range.resolution returns correct frequency labels like year, quarter, month, day, hour, minute, second, millisecond, microsecond
test_period_range_resolution: test pd.period_range with various freq arguments and assert the resolution property matches expected string labels
test_freq_to_resolution_mapping: test the mapping from frequency strings (Y, Q, M, D, h, min, s, ms, us) to their resolution labels (year, quarter, month, day, hour, minute, second, millisecond, microsecond)
test_period_range_creation: create a period range using pd.period_range with start date, number of periods, and frequency argument
test_resolution_property: test the resolution property of a pandas PeriodIndex to confirm it returns the human-readable frequency label
